what: the ITCH/OUCH trading path (brief 110's blocks with build rm_gp_itch's adapter, builder and multiplexer)
rtl_source: the files of designs/b110_itch_ouch/rtl and designs/b96_kr260_10g/rm_gp_itch/rtl named in rtl (staged into one directory)

bench.description: the independent UVM 1.2 bench of brief 170 in xsim 2026.1 (reference model written from the specifications; scoreboard, assertions, functional coverage), tests t_smoke, t_mold, t_tail, t_badfcs, t_book, t_risk, t_hdr, t_bp, t_mix:1, t_rand:1, t_rand:2, stopped at the first failing test; build and run of each mutant from the mutated copy

timeout_policy: A bench run that exceeds its time limit is `timed_out`: it is not counted as killed and not as a survivor; it is listed, and the worst-case score counts it as a survivor. A formal run that exceeds its limit is `undecided`, handled the same way. Neither is ever counted as a kill.

filter.method: miter: BMC, then register-matched induction (yosys equiv_induct), then an unbounded proof (sby)
filter.start_state: registers without an initial value start at 0 in both versions
